★Request
Light O moves forward.
It's my job.

I'll carve it.
There should be a chisel and mallet somewhere...

Enduring the freezing midwinter river, refusing to cut corners on the meticulous work,
and unfazed by the soot and dirt—Believe saw everything through to the very end.

I don't want to hear that from someone who ran off on her own three times!
...A-Anyway, good work, Believe. Are you holding up alright?

Yes.
I got dirty, so I'm going to change.
No, I don't need any.

Come on, eat up, eat up! With this many Umamusume around,
no matter how much hot pot we make, it'll disappear in the blink of an eye~.
Yes. It's my job.

I see my job through.
—That is all.

Hoo, hoo, hoo—hooah...
—Hahh...!!

Right on time. Actually, ahead of schedule. As expected of Believe. A far cry from
Durandal, who forgot items twice and was running around in a frantic mess.

Alright, next group!
Gather at the starting line!

No. I'm fine on my own.
...I was the one who asked to do it alone.

This stove is broken.
Ah, the support stone... It got old and collapsed.
With few words, yet absolute resolution, she states her conviction.

If that's the case, we'll need even more hands. I apologize for calling out so
suddenly, but when I offered to help her prepare the stoves—

I will not let you escape!
Third Blade: Flight of Olivier!

We're nearing the halfway mark of this joint winter training camp. We've got
a hot pot party to look forward to this afternoon, so let's give it our all first!
...Mm. That one... submerged down there—

Just working silently and meticulously. She turned down my help, leaving me with nothing
to do but watch to the end... But that sincere dedication burned brightly into my mind.
Yes!!

Alright, alright, I'm coming!! —Believe, please don't overdo it!
If you run into any trouble, just say the word!!

Starting fires is tough enough on its own, and there are so many stoves.
Won't it be too rough alone? Shall I join you over there?

Gather 'round! ...Alright everyone, good morning.
Just like I mentioned before, we'll be running mock races today!

Come now, shall we head over to the grounds as well?
Mock races certainly get you pumped up even just watching, don't they, rookie!
...Wait, ? What's wrong?

(When I turned down their help... I think I came off too harsh.
...I wonder... if I didn't hurt their feelings...)

Oh, what a spirited reply! Motivation is written all over your face!
Heheh, so fresh and energetic~.
Phew. ...Then that's fine—

It wasn't a blazing fire... but deep within her eyes, I saw an unyielding
will, quietly simmering like embers glowing deep inside a stove.
Well then. ...I have work to do, so excuse me.

I see, understood. Then you're all set.
Let's go, Durandal. You're slow. I'll leave you behind.

No one knew what she had accomplished, or how much effort she put in.
Thinking about that, I just couldn't sit still—

Light O and I are scheduled to join the grocery run, but...
Believe, I heard you're handling the stoves all by yourself. Is that true?

No, I'll do it. ...You really don't need to help.
Excuse me.
(—Clack!! —Clack!!)

Oh, fires are already lit. Good work! Alright grocery team,
unpack the supplies on this table! Tableware team, get the pots—

My, you have an eye for talent. Believe, right? She's on a provisional contract with me.
She's a girl with exceptional raw talent, especially when it comes to speed.
OOOOOHHH!! STRAIGHT. LINE. CHARGE!!

Leaving the bustling crowd behind, I instinctively run over to where she sits alone.
Believe didn't say a word about it. So no one knows.

...The fit isn't right.
It won't hold up like this.

A joint winter training camp hosted by several veteran Trainers.
I volunteered to assist in order to learn from the best.

...Too small. ...Too big.
The one over there is... No, the shape doesn't match.

This is clearly too much work for one person. I'll offer to help—
With that in mind, I followed her—Believe—to the stove area, but...
(...—The rookie Trainer from earlier.)

And so, the hot pot party began without a hitch. The joyous laughter
of the Umamusume echoed everywhere, loud enough to drown out the crackling fire.

Spending time with the teams of such skilled, experienced Trainers
was so meaningful—every single moment was a learning experience! ...Especially that day—

If only I could train such a talented girl myself one day...
With my heart full of such hopes, I finished watching the mock races.

Phew............
...Alright. Next is the last one—

Great work on the mock races, everyone! Now then, it's time for our long-awaited
hot pot party for dinner. Let's split up the tasks and get prepping. Go for it!
(Whoosh—! Crackle crackle...)
